name: 32312 · Tallahassee, FL
findings: ZIP 32312 (Tallahassee) has 171 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32312 (Tallahassee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32312 (Tallahassee) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 63 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
